thread:
Sam: Noticing repeated etcd leader flips in us-west-2 starting 11:10 UTC; controller-manager leader-election churn + failed GPU attach events.
Ivy: Grafana shows etcd leader changes ~11:10-11:12 and apiserver 500s, links: https://grafana.internal/d/etcd/leader-flips
Ravi: NetOpsBot reported packet loss on inter-rack fabric at 11:09:58, transient 25s.
NetOpsBot: event: fabric-link-3 intermittent packetloss detected 11:09:55-11:10:22.
SRE-Oncall: logs: 
```
E0415 11:10:05.123456 1 etcdserver: applyEntries error: context deadline exceeded
I0415 11:10:07.654321 1 leaderelection.go:240] failed to get lock kube-system/controller-manager: context deadline exceeded
E0415 11:10:09.000000 1 apiserver: http: Accept error: accept tcp 0.0.0.0:6443: accept4: too many open files
```
Sam: Sequence looks like fabric packet loss -> etcd leader flip -> controller-manager re-elections -> reconciliation spikes -> apiserver FD pressure -> GPU attach timeouts.
Ivy: mitigation: temporarily bump controller-manager leaseDuration to 20s, cordon flappy GPU nodes, and scale apiserver 3->4.
Ravi: NetOps rerouted traffic around fabric-link-3 at 11:14, packet loss stopped.
SRE-Oncall: applied fixes; apiserver FD back to 58% by 11:18, GPU attaches resumed.
Sam: follow-ups: 1) add fabric-link health gating into provisioner, 2) add an alert for leader-election >2/min, 3) run a small chaos test for short network partitions.
Ivy: cost impact minimal (~0.5% for the region for 2h) to keep GPU jobs healthy, approved.
Ravi: filed INC-5012 and assigned to netops+infra for root cause analysis.
SRE-Oncall: monitoring for 4h; will reopen on repeat leader flips or FD >80%. :thumbsup:
